correctness.rationale: At every binary level, fair sum/min gives P(root>0)=r exactly, since (2r-r²+r²)/2=r. Conditioning on positivity gives μ_{m+1}=(1−r)μ_m+(r/2)(μ_m*μ_m+Min₂ μ_m)=μ_m+r(μ_m*μ_m−Max₂ μ_m)/2. Independent coupling gives 2-Lipschitz ℓ¹ vector field and ||Φ||₁≤1, hence global probability-simplex flow ν_t and Euler TV error ≤r(e^{2mr}−1)/4. Stochastic monotonicity of the update from δ₁, explicit U₁(t)=2/(t+2) and U_k′=[P(Y+Y′≤k)−U_k²]/2 force finite-set escape as t→∞. The comparison at m=⌊T/r_N⌋ proves the large-clock regime without falsely extending the finite-time error to unbounded times; TV δ₁ and ν_λ cover the other regimes. Exact check of original rational full/conditional update for finite depths was independently replayed, not used as universal proof.
